newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Three injured as blasts rock Pakistan's Karachi.
newsitem.headline: Three injured as blasts rock Pakistan's Karachi.

text.p: Three bomb blasts rocked the Pakistani port city of Karachi on Wednesday, injuring at least three people, police and ambulance workers said.

Ambulance workers said at least three people were injured in the second blast behind the Sindh Secretariat government offices but there were no immediate reports of casualties from the other two explosions.
Police said nobody was injured in the first blast outside the Pakistan International Airlines cargo office in the city's district South.
Witnesses said the explosion shattered the windows of several nearby offices and banks.
One ambulance worker said a third explosion blew up a garbage dump at the Defence Society.

There was no immediate claim of responsibility but one government official said he suspected a political group was behind the explosions after the arrest of one of its activists on Tuesday. The official declined to give the group's name.
More than 300 people have been killed so far this year in the violence-plagued city, compared with more than 2,000 people last year, in sectarian, ethnic and political strife.
